description: ODRÉ (NaTran, Teréga, GRDF and local distributors) annual biomethane production per injection site, metered, GWh HHV (PCS, 0 °C), next to the site's theoretical production capacity as published at the date of download (capacité théorique de production à date). Kept: years 2023–2025, sites in service at least one full calendar year before (commissioned ≤ year − 2), capacity > 0. The capacity basis is not defined by the publisher; agricultural sites inject a median 1.00 of it, so it is read as the planned annual output, not nameplate × 8 760 h. No feedstock per site: the model cannot be run per plant.
